router_body:
name: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: full job set selected
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: echo 'SELECTED plan-test linux tier'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
      - name: local gate wiring proof
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: python3 -I ci/local-gate-test.py
      - name: local evidence gate
        if: ${{ !(github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix')) }}
        run: echo 'Local gauntlet evidence is the gate; request ci or full-matrix for CI.'

ci.yml.plan-test:
needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'plan-test')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python3 -I tests/tiers.py
ci.yml.linux:
needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'linux')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: docker build -t ligature-oracle -f ci/oracle.Containerfile ci
      - run: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/work" ligature-oracle bash -c 'tools/fetch-toolchain && tools/fetch-bundle && tools/check --require-licensed-bundle'
      - if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: linux-evidence
          path: target/evidence
ci.yml.tier:
name: tier ${{ needs.plan.outputs.tier || 'unplanned' }}
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    needs:
      - plan
      - plan-test
      - linux
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: python3 -I ci/tiers.py verdict
